vocabulary.meaning_en: a small animal with long ears

vocabulary.meaning_en: a colourful bird that can copy words
a small insect; also a small illness or a computer error
vocabulary.meaning_ar: حشرة صغيرة؛ عدوى خفيفة؛ خلل برمجي
vocabulary.note_ar: لها عدة معانٍ: حشرة، فيروس خفيف (a stomach bug)، خطأ برمجي، وكفعل: يُزعج.
vocabulary.note_en: Many meanings: insect, mild illness (a stomach bug), computer error, and as a verb 'to annoy'.
vocabulary.example: There's a bug in this app.
It rained continuously for two days.
I was bored during the long meeting.
They opened a trendy café downtown.
He has a stylish new haircut.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone a little angry
vocabulary.example: Loud noise irritates me when I'm reading.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sad because something was not as good as you hoped
vocabulary.example: I was disappointed with my exam result.
She is enthusiastic about learning English.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an activity you do for fun in your free time

vocabulary.example: The kitchen was a mess after dinner.
He is a charming and funny person.

fine_lines.title: bitten by the bug vs bug someone
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمة نفسها bug بمعنيين مختلفين تماماً: bitten by the bug = أصبحت متحمساً جداً لهواية أو نشاط. bug someone = يُزعج شخصاً.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Same word, very different meanings. 'Bitten by the bug' means you have become very keen on a hobby or activity. 'Bug someone' means to annoy someone.

examples.sentence: After one lesson, I was bitten by the cooking bug.
It really bugs me when people are late.

fine_lines.title: pet hate vs pet
fine_lines.explanation_ar: pet تعني حيواناً أليفاً، لكن في pet hate تعني «الخاص بي شخصياً»: الشيء الصغير الذي يزعجك أنت شخصياً أكثر من غيره. في أمريكا يقولون pet peeve.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A 'pet' is an animal at home, but in 'pet hate' it means 'personal, special to you': the small thing that annoys you most. Americans say 'pet peeve'.

examples.sentence: My pet hate is people talking during films.
We have two pets: a cat and a rabbit.

fine_lines.title: rabbit on vs talk
fine_lines.explanation_ar: talk فعل عادي محايد. rabbit on (about something) يعني يتكلم كثيراً جداً دون توقف حتى يمَلّ المستمعون، وفيه معنى سلبي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Talk' is neutral. 'Rabbit on (about something)' means talking for too long so that people get bored. It is negative.

examples.sentence: He rabbited on about his new phone for an hour.
Can we talk about the plan?

expressions.meaning_ar: يتكلم كثيراً دون توقف حتى يُملّ الآخرين
expressions.meaning_en: to talk for a long time so that others get bored
expressions.example: My uncle always rabbits on about his garden.

expressions.meaning_en: a very fashionable, stylish and charming person
expressions.example: Look at his jacket – he's a real cool cat.

expressions.meaning_ar: الشيء الصغير الذي يزعجك شخصياً أكثر من غيره
expressions.meaning_en: something small that annoys you very much
expressions.example: My pet hate is people who don't say thank you.

expressions.meaning_ar: خائب الأمل جداً (بريطانية، غالباً في الرياضة)
expressions.example: When our team lost in the last minute, I was as sick as a parrot.

expressions.meaning_ar: يصبح متحمساً جداً لنشاط أو هواية
expressions.meaning_en: to become very interested and excited about an activity
expressions.example: She tried running once and was bitten by the bug.

expressions.meaning_en: a complete mess; something done very badly
expressions.example: I made a dog's dinner of my first cake.

grammar.title: Comparisons with as ... as
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم as + صفة + as للمقارنة بالتساوي أو للتشبيه: as sick as a parrot، as busy as a bee، as tall as my brother. في النفي نقول not as ... as: He is not as tall as me.
grammar.explanation_en: We use as + adjective + as to say two things are equal or to make a comparison: as sick as a parrot, as busy as a bee. In negatives: not as ... as.
examples: I was as sick as a parrot.
This box is as heavy as that one.
Today is not as cold as yesterday.

questions.question: 'My pet hate is slow internet.' What does 'pet hate' mean?
choices: something that annoys me a lot
questions.explanation_ar: pet hate = الشيء الذي يزعجك كثيراً.
questions.explanation_en: A 'pet hate' is something that really annoys you.

questions.question: Complete: 'I was as sick as a ___ when we lost the final.'
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير: as sick as a parrot = خائب الأمل جداً.
questions.explanation_en: The idiom is 'as sick as a parrot' = very disappointed.

questions.question: 'Please stop rabbiting on!' The speaker wants the person to...
He tried painting last month and now he paints every day. He has been ___.
questions.explanation_ar: bitten by the bug = أصبح متحمساً لهواية.
questions.explanation_en: 'Bitten by the bug' means very keen on an activity.

questions.question: 'You made a dog's dinner of this report.' The report is...
questions.explanation_ar: a dog's dinner = فوضى، عمل سيئ.

questions.question: Who is a 'cool cat'?
questions.explanation_en: A 'cool cat' is stylish and charming.

questions.question: Which is correct?
choices: She is as busy than a bee.
She is busy as as a bee.
She is as busier as a bee.
She is as busy as a bee.
questions.explanation_en: The pattern is as + adjective + as.

questions.question: In which sentence does 'bug' mean 'a strong new interest'?
choices: There's a bug in the code.
A bug landed on my arm.
questions.explanation_ar: catch/be bitten by the bug = اهتمام وحماس جديد.
questions.explanation_en: 'Catch the bug' means get a strong new interest.
